sentence: This project studies how living systems work as integrated networks, including genetic networks, metabolic networks and ecological networks.
This project builds computational methods that analyze single-cell sequencing data, using signal processing and machine learning.
This project tries to find unrecognized post-translational modifications of proteins that come from valine metabolism and how they regulate life processes.
This project builds a weather and urban model to study how cities, their excess heat and pollution particles affect cloud formation and rainfall.
This project uses three total solar eclipses to study the corona and what leads to extreme space weather events.
This project tries to find out where horse milking began by studying proteins in ancient human dental calculus with mass spectrometry.
This project builds a service that uses computer vision and artificial intelligence to find components for a printed circuit board design.
This project builds a way for networked devices to work together on a shared goal using machine learning while sending less communication.
This project studies how the traits of birds decide when they migrate, using audio recordings of their flight calls at night.
This project studies how a community of scientists can keep improving free software that builds evolutionary trees from DNA sequence data.
This project builds learning methods that keep robots and unmanned aerial vehicles safe, so unsafe events stay very unlikely.
This project designs quantum photonic circuits that simulate hard physics problems such as quantum field theory and quantum magnetism.
This project builds sensors and design tools that extract task-relevant information at the point of capture, so less data must be moved.
This project studies how to protect digital information, using cryptography, coding theory and quantum computing.
This project builds methods and software that combine machine learning with physical knowledge to learn how dynamic systems behave.
This project studies how much information can be preserved in a quantum channel affected by noise and how to estimate channel capacities.
This project studies how changes in body temperature alter the way individual mussels differ in their proteins and how well they perform.
This project tries to make smaller, non-invasive devices that use nanosecond electrical pulses to treat neurological disorders.
